test_title: PYST 38: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - Reasoning (Held On: 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Ramu ran 60 km towards the west, turned left and ran 15 km. He then turned left and ran 40 km. In which direction is Ramu facing at the end? (All turns are 90 degrees unless specified)
solution:
Given: 

Ramu ran 60 km towards the west,

turned left and ran 15 km.

He then turned left and ran 40 km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/44bae2e1d2e2a767b09374d68c1a991c2a58a275f40ce13d6e17e47962f2096d.png] 

So, Ramu is facing **East** at the end.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
